remarks: EXCELLENT CREDIT A MUST! Ideal pied a terre for someone looking for an affordable life. Aside from monthly rent the only bills to pay are lights/ac and internet/cable! Heat and hot water are included in the monthly rent!   Gorgeous light filled one bed unit with sparkling hardwood floors, updated kitchen with Corian counter tops, newer stainless steel appliances, as well as newer energy efficient windows. Enjoy the open plan concept. In-building washer/dryer. Communal hallways also have hardwood floors, crown moldings, and have been recently refreshed.   This unit is convenient to shops, restaurants and public transportation. Great landlord! Come and enjoy an easy life!
